title: Development of a natural porcine-estrogen-receptor-based pseudo immunoassay for screening of 13 estrogens in milk and studying its recognition mechanism.
authors: Jiang, Zu Qiang; Wang, Jian Ping; Cui, Peng Lei
one_liner_zh: 该文利用猪雌激素受体开发牛奶中13种雌激素的伪免疫检测方法，并基于同源建模和分子对接研究受体-配体识别机制，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作建模，但对象为雌激素受体与激素而非TF-DNA，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: There have been some immunoassays reported for screening of the residues of estrogens in milk, but these methods can only determine one drug because of the limited recognition abilities of the used antibodies. Due to the broad specific recognition ability, receptor can be used as "special antibody" to develop pseudo immunoassay. However, there has been no article reporting the use of estrogen receptor for determination of estrogens in foods of animal origin so far. Furthermore, the recognition mechanism of estrogen receptor for estrogens have not been thoroughly studied. RESULTS: In this study, a type of magnetic probe based on 17beta-estradiol was synthesized that was used to produce the natural porcine estrogen receptor with ovarian as the source tissue. Then its recognition mechanisms for 13 estrogens were studied based on the optimal homological model. Results showed it only interacted with estrogens but did not interact with other steroid hormones. Then it was utilized as a broad specific recognition reagent to develop a direct competitive method on 96-well microplate for detection of the 13 drugs in milk. Due to the utilization of streptavidin-biotin labeled horseradish peroxidase as signal amplification system, the sensitivities for the 13 estrogens (limits of detection 0.007-0.0573 ng/mL) were improved for 33-100 folds in comparison with the use of conventional horseradish peroxidase system (limits of detection 0.31-3.53 ng/mL). This method showed no cross-reactivity with other steroid hormones, consistent with the docking result. SIGNIFICANCE: This is the first study reporting the use of magnetic probe to produce natural receptor from animal tissues, and this is also the first study reporting a natural estrogen-receptor-based method for multi-determination of estrogens in food sample. With the guidance of this study, more receptors and related analytical methods for other drugs or small molecules maybe are reported in the future.
abstract_zh: 背景：已有一些免疫分析方法被报道用于筛查牛奶中雌激素残留，但这些方法由于所用抗体的识别能力有限，只能测定单一药物。凭借广泛的特异性识别能力，受体可作为“特殊抗体”用于开发伪免疫分析。然而，迄今为止尚无文章报道使用雌激素受体测定动物源性食品中的雌激素。此外，雌激素受体对雌激素的识别机制尚未被深入研究。结果：本研究合成了一种基于17β-雌二醇的磁性探针，用于从卵巢组织中提取天然猪雌激素受体。随后，基于最优同源模型，研究了其对13种雌激素的识别机制。结果表明，该受体仅与雌激素相互作用，而不与其他类固醇激素结合。然后，将其用作广谱特异性识别试剂，在96孔微孔板上开发了一种直接竞争方法，用于检测牛奶中的这13种药物。由于采用链霉亲和素-生物素标记的辣根过氧化物酶作为信号放大系统，13种雌激素的灵敏度（检测限为0.007-0.0573 ng/mL）比使用传统辣根过氧化物酶系统（检测限为0.31-3.53 ng/mL）提高了33-100倍。该方法与其他类固醇激素无交叉反应，与分子对接结果一致。意义：这是首次报道使用磁性探针从动物组织中提取天然受体的研究，也是首次报道基于天然雌激素受体的方法用于食品样品中多种雌激素的同时测定。在本研究的指导下，未来可能会报道更多针对其他药物或小分子的受体及相关分析方法。
